EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT

This Employment Agreement is made on 2 June 2026 between Nimbus Analytics Private Limited ("the Company") and Priya Sharma ("the Employee").

1. POSITION
The Employee is appointed as Data Analyst and will report to the Head of Analytics.

2. SALARY
The Company shall pay the Employee a gross salary of Rs. 65,000 per month, payable on the last working day of each month.

3. PROBATION
The Employee will be on probation for six (6) months from the joining date. The Company may extend the probation period at its sole discretion.

4. NOTICE PERIOD AND TERMINATION
After confirmation, either party may terminate this agreement by giving sixty (60) days' written notice. During probation, either party may terminate with fifteen (15) days' notice. The Company may pay salary in lieu of notice.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY
The Employee shall not disclose any confidential information of the Company during or after employment.

6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All work created by the Employee in the course of employment belongs to the Company.

7. NON-COMPETE
For a period of two (2) years after leaving the Company, the Employee shall not join any competitor of the Company.

8. TRAINING BOND
If the Employee resigns within eighteen (18) months of joining, the Employee shall repay training costs of Rs. 1,50,000.
